MES Run Beta 25

Redesigned stop form with gray reason codes, searchable reasons and separate notes.
Add camera or gallery photos to unplanned stops. Confirm uploads photos first, with circular percentage progress on each thumbnail, then saves the stop. Failed uploads can be retried.
Photos are stored as WebP in Dropbox and linked to the stop in production history.
Uses the production MES service. Sign in with your existing authorized supervisor PIN.

apps.description: Test reporting, repairs, parts approvals, preventive maintenance and inspections with mock data only.
apps.releaseNotes:
Upkeep 0.1.0-beta.8 - task header search

Search is now an icon immediately after Available (or the current task-list heading). The separate Search text row has been removed.
Tap the icon to show search and status filters; tap the close icon to collapse them. The task-count filter remains on the right.
Task selection, Open, photo thumbnails and the session camera are unchanged.

Demo PIN: 1234. Sample data only; photos remain in-memory previews and there are no uploads or real purchases.
